awards:
第40届西班牙戈雅奖(2026)
　　最佳动画片(提名)

writer.name: 阿梅利亚·莫拉 Amèlia Mora

director.name: 安德里亚·加西亚 Adrià García

introduction: Captain Barracuda is obsessed with Phineas Crane's treasure, the most valuable and sought after by all pirates of the Caribbean. To do this, you will need Chispa´s help, a girl pretending to be a boy to survive among the wild limbs of the Barracuda crew. The finding of a Phineas Crane's memoir will be the key to reach the desired treasure and also the Chispa´s lifeline, since she is the only who can read on the boat and, therefore, the only able to decipher that "letter map" that supposes the manuscript found.
